about.title: Pulgaon’s Trusted Destination for Paints, Coatings & Surface Care
about.lead: Founded by Mr. Hakimuddin Saifuddin Bohra over 25 years ago, SB Hardware & Paints has built an unmatched reputation for product authenticity, expert surface diagnosis, and fair trade pricing across Wardha district.
story: We believe that paint is not merely a cosmetic finish—it is your home's first line of defense against monsoon water ingress, extreme summer heat, and surface wear.

As direct authorized dealers for Indigo Paints, Asian Paints, Shalimar Paints, Astral Chemicals, and Raj Yog Putty, our inventory arrives sealed straight from manufacturer depots. Every liter is guaranteed tamper-free.

With computerized tinting machinery right on the store floor, we formulate more than 10,000 designer shades within 5 minutes, ensuring seamless batch-to-batch color repeatability for projects of any scale.
about.ownerQuote: A durable paint job depends 70% on surface preparation and 30% on the topcoat. We guide our customers on the complete system so their walls look stunning for years.

faqs.question: Are the paints and putty at SB Hardware & Paints 100% original?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. We are direct authorized dealers for Indigo Paints, Asian Paints, Shalimar, Astral, and Raj Yog Putty. Every bucket and bag comes factory-sealed directly from manufacturer company depots in Maharashtra with authentic batch barcodes.

faqs.question: Can I get exact computerized color mixing for custom shades in Pulgaon?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our in-store computerized tinting machine can formulate more than 10,000+ shades from official Asian Paints, Indigo, and Shalimar fan decks within 5 minutes. You can also bring a sample cloth or tile and we will match the closest shade formula.

faqs.question: How can I fix persistent water seepage and damp walls before painting?
faqs.answer: Never apply putty directly on wet walls. Scrape off the peeling layer, treat the exposed brick/plaster with Astral Damp-Stop crystalline waterproofing barrier, allow 24 hours to cure, re-level with water-resistant Raj Yog Putty, and seal with an alkali-resistant primer before applying your washable emulsion.

faqs.question: Do you offer delivery to construction sites or homes in Pulgaon?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide same-day or scheduled delivery for paint buckets, primer drums, and putty bags throughout Pulgaon, Nachangaon, and nearby towns. You can order directly at our counter or by messaging Mr. Hakimuddin Ji on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: How do I calculate how many liters of paint I need for my house?
faqs.answer: As a general rule for 2 coats: 1 Liter of interior emulsion covers 120-140 sq.ft., 1 Liter of exterior emulsion covers 55-65 sq.ft., and 1 Kg of Raj Yog Putty covers 16-20 sq.ft. You can also use our AI Paint Advisor on this website or bring your room dimensions to our shop for a free calculation!
